artworks.title: Climbing Man with Arms Outstretched
artworks.description: The image shows a male figure in a dynamic pose. He is leaning forward with his left arm extended onto a piece of wooden debris, while his right arm is raised behind him. His head is slightly tilted downward, with his gaze directed towards the ground. The man has defined facial features, curly dark hair, and is depicted nude except for a cloth around his waist. There is a focus on the musculature of his body, with detailed anatomical features. The setting includes large wooden planks and a textured background for depth.

artworks.title: Man Pulling a Rope, His Foot Braced
artworks.description: The image shows a man sitting on a rock surface. He is positioned with his legs extended outward and torso leaning slightly forward. His face is turned downwards, showing his profile, with short, wavy hair. Detailed muscle definition is evident on the man's back and arms. He appears to be holding a tool or object in his hands, which are resting on his right knee. The background consists of textured surfaces that imitate rock or cliff faces.

artworks.title: An Entombment
artworks.description: There are two nude male figures in the image. One figure is lying on his back on a slab, with one arm hanging off the side and the other bent near his midsection. He has medium-length, slightly curly hair, closed eyes, and a relaxed expression. The second figure is positioned behind the first, shown from the back and bending slightly, with his body twisted toward the viewer. He has short, dark hair and a muscular build, holding the legs of the lying figure. The background is dark, and no clothing, jewelry, or other objects are visible.

artworks.title: Standing Man in Pensive Pose
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length portrait of a nude male figure standing in a relaxed pose. His body is slightly turned to the side, with his left hand resting on his chin and his right arm crossing his torso. His head is tilted downwards, and his gaze appears to be directed towards the ground. The man has short, curly hair that frames his face. A piece of cloth is draped around his hips, and it drapes over one side of his body. The background is rendered with a textured shading.

artworks.title: Christ on the Mount of Olives
artworks.artist: Albrecht Dürer and Georg Mack the Elder
artworks.medium: engraving hand-colored with watercolor and gouache, heightened with gold and silver, on laid paper mounted to a piece of parchment decorated with floral borders
artworks.dimensions:
printed sheet (trimmed to platemark): 17.5 × 12.8 cm (6 7/8 × 5 1/16 in.)
vellum sheet: 25 × 22.5 cm (9 13/16 × 8 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a painting of a biblical scene involving prayer and divine apparition. The artwork features a central figure in a purple robe kneeling and raising his hands in prayer towards a figure in the upper left corner, who is depicted with wings and a radiant golden halo. Around the central figure, three individuals are shown sleeping on the grass with expressions of fatigue. The background reveals a lush landscape with trees and rocks. Intricate floral patterns and animals adorn the border of the painting.

artworks.title: Fishermen by an Island Watermill
artworks.artist: Aegidius Sadeler II after Pieter Stevens
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 24.1 × 37.1 cm (9 1/2 × 14 5/8 in.), cut to platemark
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape scene with a river or pond in the foreground. Close to the water, people and animals engage in various activities. The river curves into the distance, leading to a village or town with hills in the background. A watermill is partly hidden by trees on the right. The trees are detailed, framing the sky. The color scheme is mainly grey, conveying depth and atmosphere.

artworks.title: Burg Eltz
artworks.medium: lithograph printed in pale yellow and black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is an etching showing Burg Eltz, a castle on a hill surrounded by a landscape. The view is slightly elevated, displaying the castle's structure with turrets and chimneys. A road leads to the castle, and a figure or rider is visible. Hills and mountains are in the background. The etching uses detailed lines to depict textures and depth. The color palette is sepia. The sky has birds. Brushing and shading techniques show the cliffs and trees.

artworks.title: Morning after the Masked Ball: Emil Theodor Richter at His Easel
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an artist seated in front of an easel. The figure is dressed in historical attire, holding a painter's palette and deep in thought. The scene includes a cluttered setting with various objects on the ground. Behind the artist, there is a vivid depiction of warriors and figures playing musical instruments. The drawing style is detailed and possibly reminiscent of 19th-century illustrations.

artworks.title: The Dream of Saint Joseph
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 21.4 × 14.9 cm (8 7/16 × 5 7/8 in.), cut to platemark
artworks.description: The image shows an angel pointing towards two sleeping figures below. The angel hovers in a cloud-filled environment, while the sleepers are reclined against cushioned surfaces. The oval framing has detailed patterns and motifs. The artwork features cross-hatching and line work for depth and texture.

artworks.title: The Annunciation
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 20.2 × 14.6 cm (7 15/16 × 5 3/4 in.), cut to platemark
artworks.description: The image depicts an angelic figure and another standing figure in a moment of communication, with a bird flying above. The setting shows swirling clouds and an ornate architectural element in the foreground. The figures wear flowing garments. The angel gestures with one hand and the other figure appears to be listening or responding. Intricate linework and shading create depth and detail in the scene.

artworks.title: Monsieur dessine un paysage
artworks.description: The image depicts four figures captured in a side profile view. Three individuals stand closely behind the fourth, who is seated. The seated person, assumed to be an artist, is dressed in loose-fitting attire and a cap, leaning forward while working on a canvas on an easel, holding a palette and brush. The artist's face is partially obscured by the cap and downward gaze. A middle-aged man in a tall top hat leans over the artist's shoulder, observing the canvas. Another man with a cane and a woman wearing a headscarf and coat stand close by, also looking at the painting. The background shows a rough terrain with a hill and sparse vegetation, suggesting an outdoor painting setting. The scene implies a rural or less developed area.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.artist: Johann Andreas Benjamin Nothnagel, in the manner of Rembrandt van Rijn
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint on laid paper

artworks.title: Cattle Dealer on Horseback
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated on a horse in a rustic setting.

artworks.title: Farm Houses by a River with a City Beyond
artworks.artist: Aegidius Sadeler II after Pieter Stevens
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image is an engraving of a rural scene featuring a cottage and surrounding landscape. The artwork shows a view of the buildings and activities within the scene from a slightly elevated perspective. People are engaging in various activities near a wooden structure, with ducks and a child nearby. A wooden cottage is surrounded by trees, creating a countryside setting. In the distance, a village with a church tower is visible under a partly cloudy sky. The sun shines through the clouds, casting rays across the sky. The engraving is detailed, with fine lines creating texture and depth in the trees and cottage. The color palette is monochrome, using shades of grey to define contrast and detail.

artworks.title: Ancient Trees by a Mountain Watermill
artworks.artist: Aegidius Sadeler II after Pieter Stevens
artworks.dimensions: plate: 23.9 × 37.5 cm (9 7/16 × 14 3/4 in.), cut to platemark
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape scene with large trees dominating the upper half. A body of water with ships and cliffs can be seen in the distant left. A water wheel is visible to the right among the trees. Near us, a group of people, including one on horseback, are gathered near a large tree. The engraving features fine line work creating texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic, mainly in black and white. The scene harmoniously blends nature and human activity.

artworks.title: Gondolas on a River by a Palace
artworks.artist: Aegidius Sadeler II after Pieter Stevens
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 23.2 × 36.6 cm (9 1/8 × 14 7/16 in.), cut to platemark
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated view of people and architectural elements. The horizon is high, with trees and distant buildings at the top. The lines are finely etched with cross-hatching for texture. The color palette is monochromatic gray. Figures are near a stone structure, with a path leading to a waterway. Boats are on the water with passengers and rowers. Buildings with towers and walls are in the distance on the right side.

artworks.title: Night Fishing near Fortified Bridges
artworks.artist: Aegidius Sadeler II after Pieter Stevens
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 23.8 × 37.4 cm (9 3/8 × 14 3/4 in.), cut to platemark
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a detailed engraving of a riverside scene with architectural elements. In the foreground, two figures stand by small boats on the riverbank. Across the water, large stone structures, including an archway and a bridge, are prominent. A grand building or castle can be seen in the distance, surrounded by hills and trees. The engraving features finely etched lines and shading, creating a textured image. The color scheme is monochromatic, emphasizing light and dark contrasts. Trees frame the architectural elements, blending nature and man-made structures.

artworks.title: Riverscape with Fishermen by a Fortified Town
artworks.artist: Aegidius Sadeler II after Pieter Stevens
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 23.2 × 37.2 cm (9 1/8 × 14 5/8 in.), cut to platemark
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a riverside scene. In the distance, buildings and trees are visible against a clouded sky. The brushstrokes resemble an engraving with fine lines creating texture. The color palette is monochromatic with black, gray, and white. People are shown near the riverbank, with boats on the water. Trees frame the scene, and clouds swirl in the background.

artworks.title: Hunters in a Forest near a Wooden Bridge
artworks.artist: Aegidius Sadeler II after Pieter Stevens
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a dense forest with tall trees forming a canopy overhead. There is a narrow opening in the foliage, revealing a distant structure on the horizon. The artwork depicts detailed lines capturing the texture of the trees and bark. The color scheme is black, white, and gray. Figures are seen near us, some observing the scenery. Rocks and a wooden bridge are scattered among the trees.

artworks.title: Travelers Resting in a Mountain Forest by a Log Bridge
artworks.artist: Aegidius Sadeler II after Pieter Stevens
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image displays an etched landscape depicting a densely wooded area with ancient, twisted trees, rocks, and dense foliage. In the foreground, three figures in period attire stand around a large tree, while two figures are seen crossing a wooden bridge in the distance to the right. The etching showcases intricate lines and cross-hatches, creating a monochromatic color palette of black, gray, and white throughout the composition.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man, Yale University
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing indoors. He is facing slightly to the right but looking forward with a direct gaze. The man has a short beard and mustache, and a contemplative expression. He is dressed in a buttoned jacket, trousers, boots, and a cap. He is holding a large, box-shaped object by a handle resting against his shoulder. In the background, there is a wooden chair with ornate carvings and upholstery, and a draped curtain with a patterned edge. The wall has a painted floral design above a wainscoting.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Group, Yale University
artworks.creditLine: Robert B. Menschel and the Vital Projects Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts six individuals standing outdoors in a grassy area. There are four men and a child to the right of a tree, with one man and the child on the left. The child is in the center, wearing a hat and a dark jacket. The men are dressed in suits, waistcoats, bowler hats, and some wear bow ties. The individuals' facial features and hair are partially obscured. In the background, there are two buildings, one resembling a house with visible windows and shutters, and the other a larger structure, possibly an institutional building. There is a fence and trees in the area.

artworks.title: The Artist's Daughter Eleonora Reclining on a Chaise-Longue
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash on light blue multicolor fiber wove paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a person's upper body in a reclining position. The person is leaning back with their eyes closed and a serene expression. They have short hair and are wearing a ruffled dress with intricate patterns. There are no visible accessories or objects in the image. The background is plain.

artworks.title: A Summer Evening at the Lago Maggiore
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper, mounted on paperboard
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a winding path bordered by rocks and shrubs. In the distance, there is a village with houses and a building with a small tower, potentially a church. Mountains rise behind the village, leading to a horizon with a lake extending towards distant hills and mountains. The painting has delicate yet detailed brushstrokes, using warm colors like earthy browns, lush greens, and shades of blue and purple.
